name: application-dish-card
title: Dish Card
description: Food-menu item card with a photo, dietary tag, rating, price, and a quick-add action, distinct from application-product-card since it carries food-specific framing (dietary tags, spice level, order language) rather than generic e-commerce cart semantics.
useWhen: Displaying a restaurant or food-delivery menu item with a photo, description, and price.
Surfacing dietary information (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free) or a spice-level indicator for a dish.
Letting a user add an item to their order or adjust its quantity once added.
avoidWhen: The item isn't food — use application-product-card for general e-commerce products instead.
No real dietary or spice data is available — omit the tag rather than guessing or defaulting it.
The layout needs to show a full nutrition breakdown — this card is a menu-browsing summary, not a detail page.
responsiveBehavior: Variant 1's vertical card has a fixed max width suited to a menu grid; Variant 2's horizontal row spans its container width and truncates the name and description with an ellipsis on narrow screens.
accessibility: The star rating uses role='img' with an aria-label stating the numeric rating, not just filled star icons.
The spice-level chilis in Variant 2 are grouped under a single role='img' with an aria-label naming the level in words (e.g. 'Hot'), not conveyed by icon count alone.
The quantity stepper's increase/decrease buttons carry real aria-labels since they are icon-only.

variants.title: Menu card
variants.description: Vertical menu-item card with a photo, dietary tag, rating, price, and an Add to order button.
accessibility: The dish photo carries descriptive alt text naming the dish, not just 'food photo'.

variants.title: Menu card (Dark)
variants.description: Vertical menu-item card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Dietary tag and price text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Order row with quantity
variants.description: Horizontal menu row with a spice-level indicator and a quantity stepper for an item already added to the order.
accessibility: The quantity stepper buttons carry real aria-labels ('Decrease quantity', 'Increase quantity').

variants.title: Order row with quantity (Dark)
variants.description: Horizontal order-row dish card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Stepper button and quantity text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
